title: Division of Workforce Services Law (Arkansas Code, Title 11, Chapter 10)
verified_how: Expanded 'Title 11 Labor and Industrial Relations' in the official public-access table of contents: 'Chapter 10 Division of Workforce Services Law' is listed live, while neighbouring repealed chapters are flagged (e.g. 'Chapter 11 Employment Offices and Agencies [Repealed.]', 'Chapter 13 Arkansas Conservation Corps Act [Repealed.]'). Chapter 16 'PUBLIC EMPLOYEES' UNEMPLOYMENT COMPENSATION' is a separate live chapter.
notes: This is Arkansas's unemployment insurance law (benefits, claims, employer contributions), administered by the Division of Workforce Services. Table-of-contents-level verification only.
